quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: CHMP recommends EU approval of Roche's Ocrevus for children (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The EMA's CHMP recommended approval of Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) IV infusion for paediatric patients aged 10 years and older with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis; a final European Commission decision is expected in the near future. The U.S. FDA approved Ocrevus for paediatric RMS patients in May 2026. Basis is the Phase III OPERETTA 2 study: non-inferior to fingolimod on relapse control (48% relapse-risk reduction vs fingolimod) and superior on brain lesions (new or enlarging T2 lesions -48%, gadolinium-enhancing active T1 lesions -87%), with safety aligned to the established profile across more than 525,000 adult patients globally. The company cites at least 40,000 children and adolescents living with MS worldwide, roughly one-third in Europe.
